<user_query>
In repo C:\Users\KickA\Projects\Active\NeuralShell, build a comprehensive inventory of interactive controls in the MAIN NeuralShell shell UI (not every modal/ecosystem GTM panel unless reachable from default operator view).

Focus on these areas and read the actual onClick/handlers:
- src/renderer/src/App.jsx (shell composition, what's always visible)
- LayoutControlBar.jsx
- TopStatusBar.jsx
- ThreadRail.jsx
- WorkbenchRail.jsx
- WorkspacePanel.jsx
- MultiWorkspace.jsx (if used in main path)
- RitualTerminal.jsx
- OmegaTrustStrip.jsx
- OnboardingProgressRail.jsx
- CommandPalette.jsx
- SettingsDrawer.jsx (open button + key actions only)
- WatchdogStatusBadge / runtime alerts
- PrimaryWorkspaceRegion.jsx
- ActiveProfileBar.jsx
- UserHud.jsx

For EACH interactive control, classify:
- REAL: wired to meaningful product behavior
- WEAK: does something minor (fills prompt, opens palette only, etc.)
- THEATER: gamification/cosmetic/misleading label
- GATED: only works in internalGtmMode or operator license
- DEAD: disabled or no handler

Return structured markdown grouped by component file with: control label/testid, classification, what it actually does (1 line).

Be thorough for the default operator shell layout.
</user_query>

I'll scan the main shell components and trace each control's handlers to classify what's real, weak, theater, gated, or dead.

[REDACTED]

# NeuralShell Main Shell — Interactive Control Inventory

**Scope:** Default operator layout with `USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL === true` in `App.jsx` (center chat = `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` → `MultiWorkspace` + `UserHud`, not legacy `WorkspacePanel`). Side rails and top bar are always composed. `internalGtmMode` gates some More-menu entries only.

**Legend:** REAL = meaningful product behavior · WEAK = minor / prompt-only / palette-only · THEATER = gamification or misleading label · GATED = `internalGtmMode` or operator license · DEAD = disabled or no handler

---

## `App.jsx` (always-visible shell chrome)

| Control (testid / label) | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| `session-lock-banner` + `session-lock-unlock-btn` | REAL | Shown when active workflow is locked; opens unlock passphrase dialog. |
| Overlay backdrop (left/right rail) | REAL | Click dismisses thread/workbench overlay panels. |
| `thread-rail-overlay-resize-handle` / `workbench-rail-overlay-resize-handle` | REAL | Drag-resizes overlay rails; double-click resets width. |
| `CommandPalette` mount (`showPalette`) | REAL | Opened via EXEC / Ctrl+K from `TopStatusBar`. |
| `SettingsDrawer` mount (`showSettings`) | REAL | Opened via settings gear / Ctrl+,. |
| `AdaptiveLayoutEngine` (via Layout **Customize**) | REAL | Opens panel/preset customization modal. |
| `RuntimeAlertsDrawer` (via watchdog badge) | REAL | Opens watchdog alert list. |

**Composition (default path):** `TopStatusBar` → `LayoutControlBar` → `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion` (inline `ThreadRail`, `MultiWorkspace`, inline `WorkbenchRail`, `ScratchpadTab`).

**Legacy path (`USE_RECOVERY_CENTER_SHELL === false`):** center = `WorkspacePanel` instead of `MultiWorkspace` (documented below).

---

## `TopStatusBar.jsx`

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| `nav-back-btn` | REAL / DEAD | Calls `onGoBack` (shell nav history); disabled when `!canGoBack`. |
| `nav-forward-btn` | REAL / DEAD | Calls `onGoForward`; disabled when `!canGoForward`. |
| `trust-indicator` (NeuralShell + green dot) | THEATER | Brand/version display only; pulsing dot is cosmetic. |
| `header-omega-posture-badge` | REAL | Runs `/omega` via `onRunOmega` → `executeSignal('/omega')`. |
| `tier-badge` | GATED / REAL | PREVIEW/AUDITOR: click prompts license → `settings.update({ tier: 'OPERATOR' })`. OPERATOR: display only. |
| Model `<select>` (no testid) | WEAK | Updates shell `model` in local state (`useNeuralState`); does not itself reconfigure bridge profile. |
| `clock-calendar-btn` | REAL | Opens Operator Calendar drawer (`onOpenCalendar`). |
| `collab-status-pill` | THEATER | Read-only collab status display (not clickable). |
| `presence-pill` | THEATER | Live latency/model tooltip display; not clickable. |
| `watchdog-status-badge` | REAL | Opens runtime alerts drawer. |
| `command-palette-btn` (**EXEC**) | REAL | Opens command palette. |
| `support-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Support Ops (Discord + support console). |
| `more-menu-btn` | REAL | Toggles More dropdown. |
| `analytics-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Analytics drawer. |
| `ecosystem-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Ecosystem launcher. |
| `mission-control-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Mission Control panel. |
| `fleet-control-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Fleet Control panel. |
| `institutional-command-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Institutional Command console. |
| `demo-flow-open-btn` | GATED | Only wired when `internalGtmMode`; opens Demo Flow console. |
| `field-launch-open-btn` | GATED | Only wired when `internalGtmMode`; opens Field Launch center. |
| `task-manager-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Operator Inbox. |
| `scratchpad-open-btn` | REAL | Toggles Workpad / scratchpad drawer. |
| `feedback-btn` | REAL / DEAD | Opens Issue Assist or external GitHub issue URL; hidden if remote bridge disabled / no `openExternal`. |
| `theme-toggle-btn` | REAL | Cycles theme system → dark → light via `useUIPreferences`. |
| `settings-open-btn` | REAL | Opens Settings drawer. |
| `appliance-mode-badge` | REAL | Always clickable; opens Appliance Console. |
| `airgap-mode-badge` | REAL | Always clickable; opens Air-Gap Operations center. |
| `demo-mode-badge` | REAL / GATED | Opens Demo Flow; badge reflects demo mode flag. |

**Embedded:** `ActiveProfileBar` passed as `profileBar` (see below).

---

## `ActiveProfileBar.jsx`

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| Bar itself (`active-profile-bar`) | THEATER | Display-only when no profile loaded (component returns `null`). |
| `profile-bar-repair-btn` | REAL | Shown for drifted/tampered trust states; opens settings or first-boot repair flow. |
| `profile-bar-verify-btn` | REAL | Runs `verifyActiveProfile` (re-checks active connection profile trust). |
| `profile-bar-trust-btn` | REAL | Opens Trust Report drawer. |
| `profile-bar-settings-btn` (**Bridge**) | REAL | Opens Settings drawer (bridge section). |

---

## `LayoutControlBar.jsx`

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| `layout-preset-hud-btn` | REAL | Applies HUD rail width preset (`onApplyRailPreset`). |
| `layout-preset-compact-btn` | REAL | Applies Dense preset. |
| `layout-preset-balanced-btn` | REAL | Applies Standard preset. |
| `layout-preset-wide-btn` | REAL | Applies Spacious preset. |
| `layout-reset-panels-btn` | REAL | Resets thread + workbench rail widths to defaults. |
| `layout-customize-btn` | REAL | Opens Adaptive Layout Engine modal. |
| `layout-toggle-thread-inline-btn` (**Flows**) | REAL | Collapses/expands inline thread rail. |
| `layout-toggle-workbench-inline-btn` (**Bench**) | REAL | Collapses/expands inline workbench rail. |
| `layout-toggle-workflows-btn` | REAL | Toggles left overlay thread rail (narrow layouts). |
| `layout-toggle-workbench-btn` | REAL | Toggles right overlay workbench rail. |

**Child:** `OnboardingProgressRail` (right side) — see below.

---

## `OnboardingProgressRail.jsx`

| `firstboot-progress-rail` / `firstboot-progress-chip` | THEATER | Progress display; hidden when all steps complete. |

| `firstboot-reset-btn` | REAL | Resets first-boot progress and reopens wizard. |

---

## `ThreadRail.jsx`

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| Workflow search `<input>` | REAL | Filters session list locally. |
| `new-thread-btn` | REAL / DEAD | Opens create-session dialog; disabled in `auditOnly`. |
| `session-item-{name}` | REAL | Selects/switches workflow session (`onSelectSession`). |
| `save-active-session-btn` | REAL / DEAD | Persists active session; disabled in `auditOnly`. |
| `lock-active-session-btn` | REAL / DEAD | Locks active session with passphrase flow; disabled in `auditOnly`. |
| `retry-save-session-btn` | DEAD / REAL | Enabled only when `saveStatus.state === 'error'`; retries save. |
| `session-autolock-toggle` | REAL / DEAD | Toggles auto-lock-on-blur; disabled in `auditOnly`. |
| `threadrail-upgrade-pro-btn` | WEAK | Opens Pro upgrade URL in browser (`handleUpgradeToPro`). |
| `session-rail-status` | THEATER | Read-only save/hydration status text. |

## `PrimaryWorkspaceRegion.jsx`

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| `thread-rail-resize-handle` | REAL | Drag-resize inline thread rail; double-click reset. |
| `thread-rail-mini-expand-btn` | REAL | Expands collapsed thread rail. |
| `workbench-rail-resize-handle` | REAL | Drag-resize inline workbench rail; double-click reset. |

**Note:** Inline `WorkbenchRail` here is **not** passed `omegaReport` / `onRefreshOmega` (unlike legacy `App.jsx` branch), so OMEGA strip data is empty until `/omega` is run from the strip button.

**Children:** full `ThreadRail`, `MultiWorkspace`, `WorkbenchRail`, lazy `ScratchpadTab`.

---

## `MultiWorkspace.jsx` (default center workspace)

### Tab bar

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| Pane tab (click row) | REAL | Sets active pane (`ms.setActivePaneId`). |
| Pane tab close (X) | REAL | Removes pane when `panes.length > 1`. |
| **New** (+) | REAL / DEAD | Opens new-pane popover; disabled at `MAX_PANES`. |
| Layout buttons (Tabs / 2-Split / 3-Split / 4-Split / Grid) | REAL | Changes multi-pane layout mode. |
| **Projects** | REAL | Opens `projects-mode` side panel. |
| **Agents** | REAL | Opens `agent-store` side panel. |
| `workspace-pane-counter` | THEATER | Display-only pane index / max. |

### New pane popover

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| Label / Agent / Project / Model fields | REAL | Configure new pane metadata. |
| **+ Create Pane** | REAL | Adds pane via `ms.addPane`. |
| **Cancel** | REAL | Closes popover. |

### Desktop context menu (`desktop-context-menu`)

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| **Open New Window** | REAL | Calls `onOpenNewWindow` (Electron new window). |
| **Open New Chat** | REAL | Creates new session or pane. |

### `PaneEmptyState` (empty pane)

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| **Launch proof lane** | REAL | Sends `/proof` to pane. |
| **Run security sweep** | REAL | Sends `/guard` to pane. |
| `CapabilitiesMatrix` action buttons | REAL | Runs mapped slash commands via `onCommand`. |
| Starter cards (`card-help`, `card-proof`, etc.) | REAL | Sends respective slash commands or study-coach prompt. |
| Suggested prompt chips | WEAK | Prefills pane prompt only (`onUpdatePane({ prompt })`). |
| Deadline chips | THEATER | Read-only upcoming deadline display. |

### `PaneChat` (active pane)

| Control | Class | What it actually does |
|---|---|---|
| Pane label (double-click) | REAL | Inline rename pane. |
| Model `<select>` | WEAK | Updates pane-local model string (per-pane, not global bridge). |
| Agent mode `<select>` | WEAK | Sets pane `agentMode` label/context for suggestions. |
| Clear chat (trash) | REAL | Clears pane chat log. |
| Message **copy** | REAL | Copies message to clipboard. |
| Message **retry** | REAL | Resends last user message for regeneration. |
| **Stop** (streaming) | REAL | Calls `window.api.llm.cancelStream()`. |
| `SmartSuggest` chips | WEAK | Sends or applies follow-up suggestion text. |
| `SmartSuggest` dismiss | WEAK | Hides suggestion row for session. |
| `composer-send-btn` | REAL | Sends pane prompt via `ms.sendMessage` → app `executeSignal`. |
| `chat-input` textarea | REAL | Enter sends; composes slash/history locally in pane. |

**Keyboard:** Ctrl+T new pane, Ctrl+W close pane, Ctrl+P projects panel.

---

## `WorkbenchRail.jsx`

## Cross-cutting gates (affect many controls)

| Condition | Effect |
|---|---|
| `runtimeTier === 'AUDITOR'` (`auditOnly`) | Write actions DEAD in ThreadRail, composer send (non-allowlisted `/` cmds), attachments, offline kill, session buttons. Allowlisted: `/help`, `/proof`, `/roi`, `/status`, `/workflows`, `/guard`, `/omega`, `/kernel`, `/clear`. |
| `internalGtmMode === false` | Demo Flow + Field Launch entries absent from More menu (GATED). |
| PREVIEW + `tier-badge` click | Operator license prompt (GATED unlock → REAL tier change). |
| `canGoBack` / `canGoForward` false | Nav buttons DEAD. |
| `saveStatus.state !== 'error'` | Retry Save DEAD. |
| `feedbackDisabled` / no `openExternal` | Feedback menu item omitted. |

---

## Summary counts (default visible shell)

| Classification | Approx. share of labeled controls |
|---|---|
| **REAL** | Session/nav/layout/palette/settings, slash execution, panels, inbox/workpad, OMEGA/watchdog, bridge settings |
| **WEAK** | Prompt prefill, palette-only “GOTO”, header model select, pane agent mode, quick-start injectors |
| **THEATER** | Ritual terminal XP, mood/RGB/collab pills, sealed/status copy, git badges, sample file viewer, proof chips, misleading GOTO labels |
| **GATED** | Tier unlock, Demo Flow, Field Launch (internal GTM) |
| **DEAD** | Conditionally disabled nav, audit-only writes, retry-save when not errored, refresh OMEGA on default workbench path, max panes New button |

**Highest-signal finding:** Default shell chat lives in **`MultiWorkspace` + `UserHud`**, not `WorkspacePanel`. **`WorkbenchRail`’s OMEGA Refresh and live report strip are partially unwired** on the recovery-center path (only `/omega` run button is reliably live). **`RitualTerminal` and route “GOTO” buttons are largely theater/weak** relative to their labels.
